검색.x: I found a good restaurant by searching online.

과학자.ex: 어릴 때 제 꿈은 과학자가 되는 거였어요.
과학자.x: When I was little, my dream was to become a scientist.
과학자.e: -자 = person who does it: 과학자, 기술자, 담당자.

환경 오염.ex: 환경 오염 때문에 많은 동물들이 살 곳을 잃었어요.
환경 오염.x: Because of environmental pollution, many animals have lost their homes.

만약.ex: 만약 내일 비가 오면 소풍을 취소할 거예요.
만약.x: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
만약.e: The first syllable means 'ten thousand', hinting at a slim chance, like 만일.
만약.t: 만약 only sets up the condition; the verb still needs -(으)면 or -는다면.

매장.ex: 이 옷은 온라인에서만 팔고 매장에서는 안 팔아요.
매장.x: These clothes are sold only online, not in stores.
매장.e: Literally 'selling place'. Homonym warning: 매장 can also mean 'burial'.

사용자.ex: 이 앱의 사용자가 천만 명을 넘었어요.
사용자.x: This app's users have passed ten million.
사용자.e: -자 = person who does it: 사용자, 운전자, 과학자.
사용자.t: In labor contexts, 사용자 also means 'employer', as opposed to 근로자 'worker'.

몰입하다.m: to be immersed in, to get absorbed in
몰입하다.ex: 영화에 너무 몰입해서 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
몰입하다.x: I was so immersed in the movie that I lost track of time.
몰입하다.t: Pronounced [모리파다]; 몰입감 describes immersive games, dramas and films.

상호 작용.ex: 아이들은 친구와의 상호 작용을 통해 배워요.
상호 작용.x: Children learn through interaction with their friends.
상호 작용.t: Often written without a space: 상호작용.

원칙.ex: 저는 거짓말을 하지 않는 것을 원칙으로 해요.
원칙.x: I make it a rule never to lie.
원칙.t: 원칙적으로 means 'in principle', often before an exception: 원칙적으로는 안 되지만…

유착.ex: 정치권과 기업의 유착이 큰 문제가 되고 있습니다.
유착.x: Collusion between politicians and businesses is becoming a big problem.
유착.e: Originally medical: tissues healing stuck together, hence ties that are too close.
유착.t: 정경 유착 is the fixed news term for collusion between government and big business.

배당.ex: 올해는 주주들에게 배당을 더 많이 줄 계획입니다.
배당.x: This year we plan to pay larger dividends to shareholders.

전승되다.m: to be handed down, to be passed on (traditions)
전승되다.ex: 이 민요는 수백 년 동안 입에서 입으로 전승되었어요.
전승되다.x: This folk song has been handed down by word of mouth for hundreds of years.
전승되다.t: 전수 is for skills given to a person; 전승 is for traditions carried through generations.

엇갈리다.m: to differ, to be divided (of opinions); to cross paths, to miss each other
엇갈리다.ex: 그 영화에 대한 평가가 크게 엇갈리고 있어요.
엇갈리다.x: Opinions on that movie are sharply divided.
엇갈리다.e: 엇- 'askew, crosswise' + 갈리다 'to be split': things splitting off in different directions.
엇갈리다.t: Two senses: 의견이 엇갈리다 'opinions differ' and 길이 엇갈리다 'to just miss each other'.

있는 힘껏.m: with all one's might, as hard as one can
있는 힘껏.x: He threw the ball as hard as he could.
있는 힘껏.e: Literally 'to the limit (-껏) of the strength you have'.

주역.m: leading role, key player, main driver
주역.x: He was named the key player in this championship win.

누명.m: false accusation, false charge, being framed
누명.ex: 그는 도둑이라는 누명을 쓰고 억울하게 감옥에 갔어요.
누명.x: He was falsely accused of being a thief and unjustly sent to prison.
누명.e: Literally 'shameful name' — one you don't deserve.
누명.t: An 오명 may be deserved, but a 누명 is always false: 누명을 쓰다 / 누명을 벗다.

활력소.m: source of energy, tonic, something that brings life
활력소.x: Hiking on weekends is what keeps me energized in life.
활력소.e: Literally 'element of lively power'; -소 = element or factor: 영양소, 요소.

눈에 넣어도 아프지 않다.forms: 눈에 넣어도 안 아파요 · 눈에 넣어도 아프지 않을 (+noun)
눈에 넣어도 아프지 않다.m: to adore (a child) completely, to be the apple of one's eye (lit. it wouldn't hurt even if put in one's eye)
눈에 넣어도 아프지 않다.ex: 막내딸은 눈에 넣어도 아프지 않을 만큼 귀여워요.
눈에 넣어도 아프지 않다.x: My youngest daughter is so precious I could just eat her up.
눈에 넣어도 아프지 않다.e: The eye can't bear even a speck of dust, yet the child is so dear that putting them in it wouldn't hurt.
눈에 넣어도 아프지 않다.t: Said by parents and grandparents about children or grandchildren, often with -(으)ㄹ 만큼 or before a noun: 눈에 넣어도 안 아플 손주.

추징.m: forfeiture of equivalent value; collection (of illegal gains or back taxes)
추징.ex: 법원은 피고인에게 뇌물로 받은 1억 원을 추징했습니다.
추징.x: The court ordered the defendant to forfeit the 100 million won he took in bribes.
추징.e: Literally 'pursue and collect' — taking the cash value when the item itself is gone.
추징.t: Also used for taxes: 세금을 추징하다 'to collect back taxes'.

한계효용.ex: 같은 음식을 계속 먹으면 한계효용이 줄어듭니다.
한계효용.x: If you keep eating the same food, its marginal utility decreases.
한계효용.t: Key phrase: 한계효용 체감의 법칙 'the law of diminishing marginal utility.'

보통선거.ex: 보통선거는 재산과 관계없이 모든 성인에게 투표권을 줍니다.
보통선거.x: Universal suffrage gives every adult the right to vote, regardless of property.
보통선거.e: Literally 'common election' — every adult citizen gets to vote.
보통선거.t: Korea's constitution names four election principles: 보통, 평등, 직접, 비밀선거.

금욕주의.x: The monks lived by practicing strict asceticism.
금욕주의.t: Pronounced [그묙쭈의]: the ㅁ links over to the next vowel.

삼강오륜.m: the Three Bonds and Five Relationships (Confucian moral code)
삼강오륜.x: The Three Bonds and Five Relationships were the basic ethics of Joseon society.
삼강오륜.e: Literally 'three main ropes and five human relationships'.

허망하다.ex: 오랫동안 준비한 일이 하루아침에 끝나서 허망해요.
허망하다.x: Something I prepared for so long ended overnight, and it feels so empty.

핵융합.ex: 태양은 핵융합으로 엄청난 에너지를 만들어 냅니다.
핵융합.x: The sun produces enormous energy through nuclear fusion.

서정시.ex: 김소월의 서정시는 지금도 많은 사람에게 사랑받고 있어요.
서정시.x: Kim So-wol's lyric poems are still loved by many people today.
서정시.e: Literally 'feeling-expressing poem' — short, personal and emotional, unlike an epic.

상호텍스트성.ex: 이 소설은 고전 작품과의 상호텍스트성이 뚜렷해요.
상호텍스트성.x: This novel shows clear intertextuality with classic works.
상호텍스트성.e: 상호 'mutual' + English 'text' + -성 '-ness': texts echoing each other.

문중.m: clan, family lineage (descendants of one ancestor)
문중.ex: 추석에는 문중 사람들이 모여서 성묘를 해요.
문중.x: On Chuseok, members of the clan gather to visit ancestral graves.
문중.e: Literally 'within the gate' — everyone belonging to the same family house.

경거망동.x: Don't act rashly until the situation becomes clear.
경거망동.t: Usually appears in warnings: 경거망동하지 말라 / 경거망동을 삼가다.

무색하다.ex: 그의 실력은 프로 선수가 무색할 정도예요.
무색하다.x: His skills would put a pro athlete to shame.
무색하다.e: Literally 'colorless' — something looks pale beside something better.
무색하다.t: Often in ~이/가 무색할 정도로 'so much that it puts ~ to shame'. Pronounced [무새카다].

조악하다.x: The product was as shoddy as it was cheap.

파급효과.ex: 이번 정책은 경제 전반에 큰 파급효과를 가져올 거예요.
파급효과.x: This policy will have a big ripple effect across the economy.
파급효과.e: Literally 'an effect that spreads like waves'.
파급효과.t: Pronounced [파그표과]: ㅂ and ㅎ merge into ㅍ.
